- Fix dragging and resizing the desktop widget: once it sat directly above the desktop, the move call placed it after itself, which Windows ignored.
- Show the widget on the desktop layer with MyGo 0.7.4: native UI windows are now revealed after their first frame, and the widget is detached from its hidden owner so it can stay above the desktop and below other apps.
- Update MyGo to 0.7.4 and golang.org/x/net to 0.62.0.

Download the Windows x64 or ARM64 ZIP, extract it, and run `Countdowner.exe`. Keep the `licenses/` directory. Portable and unsigned.
